description: registry.get_app_repo() only re-clones when the local checkout path is entirely missing -- it never refreshes an EXISTING stale checkout to match the remote. This means an externally-made .agentra/ change (objective.yaml edit via dashboard, a manual fix) has no effect until something else happens to force a resync. Add a lightweight staleness check (e.g. compare remote HEAD sha) before reading objective/environment on each trigger.
